title: Marlowe & Finch Alterations Intake Counter Card: Measuring, Needed-By Dates, Quotes and Fittings
content:
At the Marlowe & Finch Alterations intake counter each service class has its own intake terms. The card below gives every class's figures; a figure marked "not applicable" has no use in that class.

| Term | Express Hem & Cuff | Standard Alterations | Tailored Suiting | Formal & Evening Wear | Bridal Alterations | Leather & Specialty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Measuring appointment with the tailor required at drop-off | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Ticket must record the date the garment is needed (event date) | no | no | no | yes | yes | no |
| Calendar days between drop-off and the needed-by date below which the ticket is accepted only with rush service | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 21 | 42 | not applicable |
| Calendar days a written quote stays valid before drop-off | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Percent by which final operation charges may exceed the quote without new customer approval | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Operations beyond the quote require the customer's approval before work | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Fittings included in the price | 0 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 3 | 1 |
| Fee for each fitting beyond those included (USD) | not applicable | 15.00 | 20.00 | 25.00 | 35.00 | 20.00 |

## The card in words

- **Measuring.** Every class except Express Hem & Cuff and Standard Alterations requires a measuring appointment at drop-off.
- **Needed-by date.** Formal & Evening Wear and Bridal Alterations record the event date; their lead-day figures are 21 and 42 calendar days respectively.
- **Quotes.** A written quote stays valid for 30 calendar days before drop-off in every class, the quote-overrun tolerance figure is 10 percent in every class, and operations beyond the quote need the customer's approval in every class.
- **Fittings.** Express Hem & Cuff includes no fitting and has no extra-fitting fee; Bridal Alterations includes the most fittings (3) and has the highest extra-fitting fee (35.00 USD).

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A Bridal Alterations ticket whose event date is 40 calendar days after drop-off falls below the 42-day figure; a Formal & Evening Wear ticket with the same 40 days does not fall below that class's 21-day figure.
- In Tailored Suiting the first two fittings are included in the price; a third fitting is a fitting beyond those included.
